themes.title: Bitcoin slips below $67,000
themes.summary: Bitcoin fell below $67,000 overnight into Saturday and is down about 18.5% since mid-October and about 47% below its October 2025 record of $126,080 (CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Trading below the 200-week average
themes.summary: Price sits about 1.2% below the 200-week moving average near $67,992, with the daily RSI at about 23, below the conventional oversold level of 30 (crypto.news).

themes.title: Extreme fear in sentiment
themes.summary: The Fear and Greed Index read 13 on Saturday, down from 20 on Friday and 28 on Thursday (CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Inflation and rate-hike bets
themes.summary: October producer prices rose 6.5% from a year earlier, adding to expectations of a December Fed rate hike and a firmer dollar, which weigh on risk assets (CryptoTicker; Reuters via Central Oregon Daily).

themes.title: Liquidations and ETF outflows
themes.summary: Between $1.3 billion and $1.6 billion of crypto futures were liquidated Friday, mostly long positions; U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs saw about $1.44 billion of withdrawals over five days through Nov. 11 (CryptoTicker; crypto.news).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin was down about 1.4% and Ether about 0.3% over 24 hours early Saturday, with bitcoin's weekly loss above 10% (CoinCodex; crypto.news).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: BNB near $616 (-2.2%), XRP near $0.98 (-4.3%), Solana near $75.24 (-5.8%) and Cardano near $0.16 (-4.5%) over 24 hours (crypto.news ticker).

categories.name: DeFi tokens
categories.note: Mixed: Injective rose about 12.4%, while Aerodrome Finance and GMX were among the day's notable movers in the top 200 (CoinCodex).

categories.name: Stablecoins and liquidity
categories.note: Stablecoin supply fell $14.2 billion in the 30 days to Nov. 9, per Glassnode, and DefiLlama put stablecoin market value near $289.8 billion, down 4.6% over 30 days (CryptoTicker; crypto.news).

watch_list.why: Analysts cite about $68,000 (200-week line) and $70,000 above, and about $66,100 and the Aug. 19 close of $64,686 below (CryptoTicker; crypto.news).
With no stock market or ETF flows until Monday, order books are thinner, which can amplify moves (CryptoTicker).
Nvidia reports Tuesday and Fed minutes are due Wednesday, both closely watched for risk sentiment ahead of the December Fed meeting (Reuters via Yahoo Finance).
